test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘FAVORITE’ is written as ‘ETIROVAF’ and ‘MINIMIZE’ is written as ‘EZIMINIM’. How will ‘RESEMBLE’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**‘FAVORITE’ is written as ‘ETIROVAF’,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45f15e75e13875e3066d76aa20ce142e8d0d6d83f874efffe2ef8fc9fa09ad01.png] 

**‘MINIMIZE’ is written as ‘EZIMINIM’,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aed19a5b078ab087a8a1f8e491385d465383a2654737b986d2782f5939aa731b.png] 

Similarly,

**‘RESEMBLE’ can be written as,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/770679c74a4fbfe50afa204ec2ce79add5162a2956f5d62ab2f789ae09033501.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****ELBMESER"**.
